VANCOUVER LUXURY REALTY

Nestled on one of Kitsilano's most picturesque and sought-after streets, this exceptional two-level townhome is located just one block from the beach on charming York Avenue, surrounded by cherry blossom trees and beautiful executive residences. Offering approximately 1,499 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this home features 2 bedrooms, a den, 2 bathrooms, and stunning views of the water, mountains, and city skyline. The main level offers an inviting open-concept kitchen, a spacious dining area ideal for entertaining, a private deck, and a well-appointed bedroom and full bathroom. A private rooftop deck provides the perfect setting to relax. One covered carport parking space included. If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent. **Unfurnished is not an option**

This townhouse home located at 2535 York Avenue, Vancouver is currently for rent and has been available on Zolo.ca for 27 days. It has 2 beds, 2 bathrooms, and is 1,499 square feet. 2535 York Avenue, Vancouver is in the Kitsilano neighborhood Vancouver. Fairview VW, Arbutus and Point Grey are nearby neighborhoods.

About 103 - 2535 York Avenue, Vancouver

There are curently 30 townhouses for rent (Vancouver).

2535 York Avenue is in the city of Vancouver, British Columbia and situated in the community of Kitsilano in Vancouver. Fairview Vw, Arbutus and Point Grey are nearby neighborhoods. York Avenue has 8 postings presently on the market, while the community of Kitsilano has 223 properties on the market. That's just 4.75% of the 4,692 total properties on the market in the city of Vancouver. The average asking price of a home in Kitsilano is $1,923,068, with an estimated mortgage of $7,019 per month.* That is 1.4x the average list price of $1,349,587 in Vancouver. Properties listed in Kitsilano are an average of 1,473 sq ft, with 3 beds and 2 baths. The community around 2535 York Avenue has more houses for sale than apartments.

* Monthly payments are an estimate based on a mortgage with 20% down @ 2.65% with a 5-yr Variable rate
